messages:
ops-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: high 5xx rate on /v1/embeddings (eu-west-1). Incident ID PD-ev-9283. sample error: 500 INCOMPATIBLE_RUNTIME

pagerduty: Page sent to oncall (rotation: infra-oncall). Escalation policy: P1->P2 thresholds exceeded.

sanjay: taking pager — oncall here, starting triage. seeing lots of 500s and some 502s clustered at 02:10 UTC.

liz: joining — any recent routing/config deploys?

kevin: @sanjay I noticed a config push 02:05 by marie to routing-policies (small change). checking PR now.

marie: yep, that was me — tiny routing rule update to alias for a new variant. I did a fast patch to pin embeddings route for customers using alias `enterprise-embed-v2` to `gpt-instruct-xl` because of a build churn.

kevin: wait — pinned embeddings traffic to an *instruct* variant? that seems wrong. instruct vs embed runtime mismatch would cause model to reject payloads.

mateo: logs show repeated fallback-and-retry loops between eu-west and us-west for the embeddings route — looks like automated fallback tried to use a chat/instruct variant when embed variant unavailable, then routed back causing throttles. snippet from router logs:
```
2024-06-10T02:09:57Z router[euw]: route embeddings -> variant gpt-instruct-xl (pinned)
2024-06-10T02:10:01Z runtime[euw]: 500 INCOMPATIBLE_MODEL_SCHEMA
2024-06-10T02:10:02Z router[euw]: fallback to variant embedder-v1
2024-06-10T02:10:03Z runtime[usw]: 504 TIMEOUT
2024-06-10T02:10:04Z router[usw]: route back to pinned variant gpt-instruct-xl
```

marie: oh no, that's my change. I thought the alias pointed to embedder but it was still mapped to instruct in the alias table. My bad.

sanjay: ok mitigation plan: 1) apply temporary routing override to send embeddings traffic to safe embedder (embedder-safe-quant) 2) rollback the alias change in git 3) run a small canary to validate

kevin: I'll push the override now (short TTL) — running the override command: 
```
curl -X POST https://console.internal.redwood/api/overrides \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $INTERNAL_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/embeddings","override_variant":"embedder-safe-quant","ttl_secs":600}'
```

ops-bot: Deploy bot: routing override applied by kevin at 02:12 UTC (override id ov-7721).

mateo: metrics: errors drop from 24% -> 1.2% in eu-west within 90s of override. latency stable.

marie: opening rollback PR now to revert the alias change (PR: github.com/redwood/routing/pull/482).

liz: good. I'll notify CS for customers with higher volume in EU (listing top affected orgs: AcmeCorp, FinCheck, Learnly). prepping comms.

kevin: rolling back alias mapping now (executing revert commit).

ops-bot: GitHub: merged revert commit by kevin (commit 9a1b3c). Routing reconciliation job picked up change at 02:16 UTC.

sanjay: run smoke tests against /v1/embeddings for a handful of customers to confirm.

kevin: smoke tests pass (sample calls: OK, embedding shape correct).

marie: summary of impact: ~8m window (02:09–02:17 UTC), ~18% of embeddings requests in eu-west received 500s or retries, affect rate for top-10 customers ~ 12–25% during window. No data exfiltration, only request failures.

liz: CS notified customers and opened status update draft. sending now.

pagerduty: Incident severity recommendation: SEV2 due to multi-customer impact and production errors.

sanjay: I agree SEV2. assigning postmortem owner to marie. marie: can you capture root cause + remediation + automation to prevent alias/variant mismatch?

marie: on it — initial notes: human error in alias mapping, gap in preflight validation (we don't validate runtime compatibility for pinned aliases). proposed fixes: - pre-deploy validation to check variant capability (embed vs gen vs chat) - block pins from assigning cross-interface variants - add alert for rapid 5xx spikes correlated with config deploys

mateo: also adding a router-side sanity check: if a route type is `embeddings` and variant reports "capabilities": ["instruct","chat"], reject assignment and fail CI.

kevin: PR for validation checker drafted: github.com/redwood/routing/pull/483. putting in review.

sanjay: great. handoff: I'm leaving oncall in 20m, liz will be bridging for followups.

liz: taking handoff. will watch for any regression and chase postmortem deliverable.

marie: postmortem ETA EOD and will include changelist, affected customers, and recommended followups.

ops-bot: Incident closed (override removed, revert merged). Close reason: manual rollback + routing override mitigated error. Timestamp: 02:22 UTC.

kevin: tl;dr: mispinned alias -> incompatible variant -> fallback loop -> brief customer-facing errors; mitigated by routing override + revert.

sanjay: thanks everyone — cleanup tasks assigned in the ticket. assigning sevtwo retrospective for next week. :white_check_mark:
